etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 異 — borne on the head: to be crowned; humbly receive (頂戴).
mnemonic: Held above your own head in thanks — タイ. 頂戴: 'may I humbly have' — and toddlers' first keigo.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 隹 (phonetic スイ→だれ) — the asking word: who.
mnemonic: The bird asking at the door — だれ. 誰: the question mark's favorite kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 定 (phonetic タン) — the seam giving: to come apart; a smile breaking open (綻ぶ).
mnemonic: The stitch that lets go, the face that opens — ほころぶ. 破綻: plans at seam-failure.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 寸 (phonetic チュウ) — thrice-brewed liquor: strong sake — the 酎 of 焼酎.
mnemonic: The jar with a kick — チュウ. 酎ハイ: the izakaya's staple.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 歩 (phonetic チョク) — work walking forward: progress (進捗).
mnemonic: The task taking actual steps — はかどる. 進捗どうですか: the manager's greeting.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 貴 (phonetic カイ) — burst and collapsed: to crush (and 潰れる, to go under).
mnemonic: The dam, the shop, the plan: all 潰れる — つぶれる. 胃潰瘍's first act.

etymology: Pictograph: the downward-grasping claw — nail, talon; the radical 爫's full form.
mnemonic: The hand's hardware — つめ. 爪切り: Sunday's small ritual.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 帝 (phonetic テイ) — Buddhism's 'clear seeing' (諦観); seeing clearly enough to let go: あきらめる.
mnemonic: Understanding so complete you release it — あきらめる. 諦め: enlightenment's practical cousin.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 弱 (phonetic デキ) — too weak against the water: to drown; drowning in pleasure: to indulge (溺愛).
mnemonic: In over the head, willingly or not — おぼれる. 溺愛: love past the waterline.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 貝 + 占 (phonetic チョウ) — affixed flat: to paste (貼る).
mnemonic: The sticker claiming its spot (占) — はる. 貼り紙: the taped notice.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 石 (phonetic ト) — the stone in the chest: envy.
mnemonic: The pebble that grinds all day — ねたむ. 嫉妬's second half.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 者 (phonetic ト) — wealth on the table: to wager.
mnemonic: The shells pushed to the center — かける. 賭け: the all-in kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 屯 (phonetic トン) + 頁 — the head bowing at once: sudden; put in order (整頓).
mnemonic: Everything drops into place at once — トン. 整理整頓: the classroom poster.

etymology: Compound: words (言) that lead astray (迷) — the riddle: mystery.
mnemonic: A sentence built like a maze — なぞ. 謎: every detective series' subtitle.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 咼 (phonetic カ→なべ) — the cooking pot: pan; the communal winter meal (鍋).
mnemonic: The pot everyone's chopsticks share — なべ. 鍋: December's social contract.

etymology: A kokuji — Japan's own character for scent: fragrance (匂い).
mnemonic: The smell wrapped in air — におい. 匂い: bakery radius measurement.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 念 (phonetic ネン) — turned with force: to twist (捻挫: sprain).
mnemonic: The wrong rotation at the wrong time — ひねる. 捻挫: the basketball injury.

etymology: Phono-semantic: net (罒) + 馬 (phonetic バ) — words hurled like nets: to revile.
mnemonic: Insults at cavalry volume — ののしる. 罵声: the stadium's dark side.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 者 (phonetic チョ→はし) — the eating sticks: chopsticks.
mnemonic: Bamboo's most-used descendants — はし. 箸: three billion meals a day.

etymology: Compound: markings (文) between jades (王王) — mottled: spots.
mnemonic: The pattern between the gems — まだら. 斑点: the leopard's syntax.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 㔾 (phonetic ハン) — over the banks: to flood (氾濫).
mnemonic: The river ignoring its lane — ハン. 氾濫: the flood-warning pair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 凡 (phonetic ハン) — spreading wide over: general: pan- (汎用).
mnemonic: Flooding every use case — ハン. 汎用: general-purpose — the engineer's adjective.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 桼 (phonetic シツ) — the leg's hinge: knee.
mnemonic: The joint that files complaints on stairs — ひざ. 膝: seiza's first casualty.

etymology: Compound: the arm's measure-point (寸) in flesh (月) — elbow.
mnemonic: The arm's hinge, table-banned — ひじ. 肘: the crowded-train weapon.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 敝 (phonetic ヘイ) — screened from sight: to conceal (隠蔽).
mnemonic: The tarp over the evidence — ヘイ. 隠蔽: the scandal's second act.

etymology: Compound: the eye looking down past the blade — scorn: to despise (軽蔑).
mnemonic: The glance that files you under 'beneath' — さげすむ. 軽蔑: contempt, formalized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: insect (虫) + 夆 (phonetic ホウ) — the stinging swarm: bee, wasp.
mnemonic: The insect with a union and a sting — はち. 蜂蜜: the payoff.

etymology: Compound: the creature's face and figure — looks: appearance (美貌, 全貌).
mnemonic: The full picture, fur included — ボウ. 全貌: the whole shape of the affair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 孛 (phonetic ボツ) + 力 — bursting up: sudden outbreak (勃発).
mnemonic: Zero to conflict in one stroke — ボツ. 勃発: the war correspondent's verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 未 (phonetic マイ) — light not yet arrived: dim, obscure (曖昧).
mnemonic: The hour before clarity — マイ. 曖昧: the fog between yes and no.

etymology: Compound: the wooden headrest (木) under the sleeper (冘) — pillow.
mnemonic: The tree the head trusts — まくら. 枕: rakugo's opening word, too.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 宓 (phonetic ミツ) + 虫 — the bees' hidden store: honey.
mnemonic: The insects' secret economy — ミツ. 蜂蜜: bee plus honey, the sweet pair.

etymology: Compound: the sun covered over — deep dark: the netherworld (冥土); profound (冥想 via 瞑).
mnemonic: Where the light doesn't file reports — メイ. 冥王星: Pluto — king of the dark.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wheat (麦) + 面 (phonetic メン) — wheat drawn into strands: noodles.
mnemonic: Wheat with 面's length — メン. ラーメン's last kanji, when it bothers with one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 并 (phonetic ヘイ→もち) — pounded rice cake: mochi.
mnemonic: Rice compressed into ceremony — もち. 餅: the New Year's chewiest tradition.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 夭 (phonetic ヨウ) — uncanny allure: bewitching; the spirits (妖怪).
mnemonic: Beauty with an asterisk — あやしい. 妖怪: the folklore census.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 夭 (phonetic ヨク) — well-watered: fertile (肥沃).
mnemonic: Land that drinks well — ヨク. 肥沃: the farmer's favorite adjective.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 呂 (phonetic リョ) — one of a pair: companion (伴侶).
mnemonic: The vertebra next to yours — リョ. 伴侶: the life partner.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 貝 + 各 (phonetic ロ) — wealth routed privately: bribe — 賄's partner in 賄賂.
mnemonic: Each (各) palm gets its shell — ロ. 賄賂: the corruption pair complete.

etymology: Compound: the jade (王) turned in both hands (廾) — to toy with: to trifle (翻弄).
mnemonic: Fate spinning you like a trinket — もてあそぶ. 翻弄: waves and romances do it.
